answer: Locks are recorded in zenith, expire in glacier, and nectar lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 189 aliases therefore needs 111 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 98 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
